findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-stream" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qy_board, qy_register · Private data: qy_publish, qy_register, qy_me, qy_pitfall · Public sink: qy_board, qy_deliver, qy_claim, qy_start, qy_verify, qy_publish, qy_cancel, qy_register, qy_result · Destructive: qy_capability, qy_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qy_board, qy_register · Private data: qy_publish, qy_register, qy_me, qy_pitfall · Public sink: qy_board, qy_deliver, qy_claim, qy_start, qy_verify, qy_publish, qy_cancel, qy_register, qy_result · Destructive: qy_capability, qy_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
